research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TransAstra is researching systems and methods for radiant gas dynamic mining of permafrost, including the extraction of gas propellants from lunar and Martian polar regions, as described in 'Systems and methods for radiant gas dynamic mining of permafrost for propellant.' The company is also developing fabrication of ceramics from celestial materials using microwave sintering and manufacturing in space environments. These efforts focus on space resource prospecting, harvesting, and utilization.

press_references.value: TransAstra to Demonstrate Capture Bag on the International Space Station

product_launches.description: TransAstra's Capture Bag is designed to safely and efficiently capture orbital debris and small asteroids, supporting missions from debris cleanup to resource acquisition.

overview_description.description:
TransAstra is developing breakthrough technologies in the areas of space resources and in-space transportation to enable massive growth to existing space industries and whole new space industries. TransAstra leads the world in the technologies to find, prospect, harvest, and use space resources. Space resources include water and other valuable materials to be found on asteroids and lunar poles.

TransAstra knows how to extract these resources and use them as rocket propellant for use in today's commercial satellites and whole new industries including space tourism.

about_short_description.short_description: TransAstra develops a technology to find, prospect, harvest and use space resources.

product.name: Optical Mining
product.description: A technique using focused sunlight to extract resources from asteroids and space debris, designed to enable asteroid mining and space industrialization.

product.name: Worker Bee Orbital Transport Vehicle
product.description: An in-space mobility vehicle using solar thermal propulsion for transporting payloads, capable of using various volatiles as propellant.

product.name: Sutter Telescope Technology
product.description: A telescope system using Theia software to detect and track faint objects in space, enhancing space domain awareness.

product.name: Flytrap Capture Bag
product.description: A system using inflatable bags to capture and secure space debris and satellites, scalable for various object sizes.

product.name: Sutter Turnkey Observatory (TKO)
product.description: A modular sky survey system for space domain awareness, deployable at customer locations without the need for a traditional observatory.

product.name: AccuTilt
product.description: A tip-tilt mount for precise focal plane alignment in telescopes, improving image quality with micrometer precision adjustments.
